card.name: The word inhaled, split after in
card.fires_on: The second piece of the word "inhaled" ("haled") right after "in", mostly in drug-label text about inhaled medicines, bronchospasm and drug interactions.

modes.label: Inhaled therapies
modes.description: "haled" after "in" in phrases like "as with other inhaled therapies" or "inhaled beta agonist".

modes.label: Inhaled in drug lists
modes.description: "haled" inside interaction lists or corticosteroid route lists such as systemic and inhaled.
